title: How youngsters can learn jazz today
summary: The panel laments the lack of jam sessions; Armstrong says young players avoid older men, and recalls a boppers' remark about notes.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future
